description: `Feature` - A Feature represents a specific functionality like Email campaign, Deals, Calls, Automations, etc. on Brevo. While inviting a user, determine which feature you want to manage access to. You must specify the feature accurately to avoid errors. `Permission` - A Permission defines the level of access or control a user has over a specific feature. While inviting user, decide on the permission level required for the selected feature. Make sure the chosen permission is related to the selected feature.
